gap_question: What specific methods or studies have attempted direct quantification of microbial metabolites (e.g., inosine, SCFAs) within the human tumor microenvironment (TME) versus fecal/plasma samples in the context of ICI therapy?
requested_object: 搜索关键词：'tumor microenvironment metabolite quantification immune checkpoint inhibitor human'、'intratumoral inosine concentration cancer patients'、'paired tumor tissue plasma metabolomics immunotherapy trial'，限定 2020-2026 年，寻找是否有任何研究实际报告了人类 ICI 患者 TME 内肌苷或 SCFAs 的绝对浓度（μM、ng/mL、μmol/g）。
still_missing: 确认是否有任何已发表的人类 ICI 试验队列实际进行了 TME 代谢物定量（即使未在综述中提取具体数值）；需要检索原始研究（如 Mager et al. Science 2020、Coutzac et al. Nature Communications 2020）以验证是否包含人类 TME 浓度测量；需要搜索 ICI 试验的代谢组学数据集或临床试验注册信息，查看是否有配对组织 - 流体代谢组学分析。
success_criteria: Identification of any studies utilizing mass spectrometry or other techniques to measure intratumoral metabolite concentrations in ICI-treated patients, or confirmation that this remains a methodological gap.
user_scope: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?
